units.displayText: Several days later, Ascension Sector

spans.text: Several days later, Ascension Sector

units.rawText: First Copley, now Ascension... Your recent ventures are nothing short of thrilling.
units.displayText: First Copley, now Ascension... Your recent ventures are nothing short of thrilling.

spans.text: First Copley, now Ascension... Your recent ventures are nothing short of thrilling.

units.rawText: Any thoughts, Sueyoi?
units.displayText: Any thoughts, Sueyoi?

spans.text: Any thoughts, Sueyoi?

units.rawText: I'd much prefer it if I didn't have these experiences...
units.displayText: I'd much prefer it if I didn't have these experiences...

spans.text: I'd much prefer it if I didn't have these experiences...

units.rawText: Don't say that, you don't get these chances often. So, have you located the target?
units.displayText: Don't say that, you don't get these chances often. So, have you located the target?

spans.text: Don't say that, you don't get these chances often. So, have you located the target?

units.rawText: No. We ran the scan over each and every agent in the sector, but we had no hits.
units.displayText: No. We ran the scan over each and every agent in the sector, but we had no hits.

spans.text: No. We ran the scan over each and every agent in the sector, but we had no hits.

units.rawText: Ah. Within expectations, but unfortunate nonetheless.
units.displayText: Ah. Within expectations, but unfortunate nonetheless.

spans.text: Ah. Within expectations, but unfortunate nonetheless.

units.rawText: Sorry, Boss. My mistake.
units.displayText: Sorry, Boss. My mistake.

spans.text: Sorry, Boss. My mistake.

units.rawText: Relax. Hm... By your reports, this sector's administrator is yet to be reset, and is in a state of chaos?
units.displayText: Relax. Hm... By your reports, this sector's administrator is yet to be reset, and is in a state of chaos?

spans.text: Relax. Hm... By your reports, this sector's administrator is yet to be reset, and is in a state of chaos?

units.rawText: Yes. Before you arrived, we didn't dare use the operands available to us.
units.displayText: Yes. Before you arrived, we didn't dare use the operands available to us.

spans.text: Yes. Before you arrived, we didn't dare use the operands available to us.

units.rawText: Reset her, then. Arcadia can continue to offer protection for them in negotiations over the administrative rights.
units.displayText: Reset her, then. Arcadia can continue to offer protection for them in negotiations over the administrative rights.

spans.text: Reset her, then. Arcadia can continue to offer protection for them in negotiations over the administrative rights.

units.rawText: Even if there's no target here, we cannot sit by and leave these agents to their own devices. The Sanctifiers will not be merciful.
units.displayText: Even if there's no target here, we cannot sit by and leave these agents to their own devices. The Sanctifiers will not be merciful.

spans.text: Even if there's no target here, we cannot sit by and leave these agents to their own devices. The Sanctifiers will not be merciful.

units.rawText: Of course, in return, we'll need a certain amount of repayment.
units.displayText: Of course, in return, we'll need a certain amount of repayment.

spans.text: Of course, in return, we'll need a certain amount of repayment.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: With Sueyoi making his exit, the room's occupancy was reduced to one yet again.
units.displayText: With Sueyoi making his exit, the room's occupancy was reduced to one yet again.

spans.text: With Sueyoi making his exit, the room's occupancy was reduced to one yet again.

units.rawText: From creating a human, to a God... What a fascinating transformation of thought.
units.displayText: From creating a human, to a God... What a fascinating transformation of thought.

spans.text: From creating a human, to a God... What a fascinating transformation of thought.

units.rawText: That reminds me. If we cannot find one, then why should we not make one?
units.displayText: That reminds me. If we cannot find one, then why should we not make one?

spans.text: That reminds me. If we cannot find one, then why should we not make one?

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: Golden effulgence ebbed in and out like the very world's breath. Eosphorus sat at the Temple's highest point, immersed in thought.
units.displayText: Golden effulgence ebbed in and out like the very world's breath. Eosphorus sat at the Temple's highest point, immersed in thought.

spans.text: Golden effulgence ebbed in and out like the very world's breath. Eosphorus sat at the Temple's highest point, immersed in thought.

units.rawText: [Reporting, Border Battlefront Communications Incoming.]
units.displayText: [Reporting, Border Battlefront Communications Incoming.]

spans.text: [Reporting, Border Battlefront Communications Incoming.]

units.rawText: Put it through.
units.displayText: Put it through.

spans.text: Put it through.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier opened its outer shell. A Black Goat leaped out from within, perching on top of the Sanctifier's head.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier opened its outer shell. A Black Goat leaped out from within, perching on top of the Sanctifier's head.

spans.text: The Sanctifier opened its outer shell. A Black Goat leaped out from within, perching on top of the Sanctifier's head.

units.rawText: [Establishing Special Communications Channel, Incoming Signal—Border Battlefront Command Center]
units.displayText: [Establishing Special Communications Channel, Incoming Signal—Border Battlefront Command Center]

spans.text: [Establishing Special Communications Channel, Incoming Signal—Border Battlefront Command Center]

units.rawText: Long time no see, Hesperus. What has occurred in Tartarus?
units.displayText: Long time no see, Hesperus. What has occurred in Tartarus?

spans.text: Long time no see, Hesperus. What has occurred in Tartarus?

units.rawText: The occurrence is not at the front line. It's right in front of you, behind our lines.
units.displayText: The occurrence is not at the front line. It's right in front of you, behind our lines.

spans.text: The occurrence is not at the front line. It's right in front of you, behind our lines.

units.rawText: ...What's the matter?
units.displayText: ...What's the matter?

spans.text: ...What's the matter?

units.rawText: The details will be with Judgment upon their return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I'm here to inform you of two things.
units.displayText: The details will be with Judgment upon their return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I'm here to inform you of two things.

spans.text: The details will be with Judgment upon their return to the Reverse Babylon Tower. I'm here to inform you of two things.

units.rawText: One, a Sector-Level Irregular Agent has appeared in the Ascension Sector, and is associated with Entropy.
units.displayText: One, a Sector-Level Irregular Agent has appeared in the Ascension Sector, and is associated with Entropy.

spans.text: One, a Sector-Level Irregular Agent has appeared in the Ascension Sector, and is associated with Entropy.

units.rawText: I was not informed. But if you say so, I shall dispatch forces immediately.
units.displayText: I was not informed. But if you say so, I shall dispatch forces immediately.

spans.text: I was not informed. But if you say so, I shall dispatch forces immediately.

units.rawText: No need. I have instructed Judgment to initiate the reset process.
units.displayText: No need. I have instructed Judgment to initiate the reset process.

spans.text: No need. I have instructed Judgment to initiate the reset process.

units.rawText: ...Hesperus, like I said before, we cannot be this uncouth.
units.displayText: ...Hesperus, like I said before, we cannot be this uncouth.

spans.text: ...Hesperus, like I said before, we cannot be this uncouth.

units.rawText: Save that for when you don't need me to clean up behind you.
units.displayText: Save that for when you don't need me to clean up behind you.

spans.text: Save that for when you don't need me to clean up behind you.

units.rawText: Apologies, I am to blame for that. What of the second article?
units.displayText: Apologies, I am to blame for that. What of the second article?

spans.text: Apologies, I am to blame for that. What of the second article?

units.rawText: I'm not finished with number one yet. I initiated the reset, but the sector reset failed. You know what that means.
units.displayText: I'm not finished with number one yet. I initiated the reset, but the sector reset failed. You know what that means.

spans.text: I'm not finished with number one yet. I initiated the reset, but the sector reset failed. You know what that means.

units.rawText: I'm aware.
units.displayText: I'm aware.

spans.text: I'm aware.

units.rawText: Two, the Sector-Level Irregular Agent in the Ascension Sector is not only associated with Entropy, but is also a result of the actions of a certain Greater Sanctifier much favored by you.
units.displayText: Two, the Sector-Level Irregular Agent in the Ascension Sector is not only associated with Entropy, but is also a result of the actions of a certain Greater Sanctifier much favored by you.

spans.text: Two, the Sector-Level Irregular Agent in the Ascension Sector is not only associated with Entropy, but is also a result of the actions of a certain Greater Sanctifier much favored by you.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' countenance grew grim.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' countenance grew grim.

spans.text: Eosphorus' countenance grew grim.

units.rawText: Hesperus, those are harsh words.
units.displayText: Hesperus, those are harsh words.

spans.text: Hesperus, those are harsh words.

units.rawText: The evidence is with Judgment. I will leave interrogation and the dealings after to you.
units.displayText: The evidence is with Judgment. I will leave interrogation and the dealings after to you.

spans.text: The evidence is with Judgment. I will leave interrogation and the dealings after to you.

units.rawText: ...[Connect with the Room of Cogitations.]
units.displayText: ...[Connect with the Room of Cogitations.]

spans.text: ...[Connect with the Room of Cogitations.]

units.rawText: [Connecting to the Room of Cogitations... Error... Error...]
units.displayText: [Connecting to the Room of Cogitations... Error... Error...]

spans.text: [Connecting to the Room of Cogitations... Error... Error...]

units.rawText: [Reporting, the Room of Cogitations has been severed from the core of the Reverse Babylon Tower.]
units.displayText: [Reporting, the Room of Cogitations has been severed from the core of the Reverse Babylon Tower.]

spans.text: [Reporting, the Room of Cogitations has been severed from the core of the Reverse Babylon Tower.]

units.rawText: Hmph. It would appear that interrogation is no longer necessary.
units.displayText: Hmph. It would appear that interrogation is no longer necessary.

spans.text: Hmph. It would appear that interrogation is no longer necessary.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, I know that you always seek to walk the path of clemency, to strive for alteration and acceptance.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, I know that you always seek to walk the path of clemency, to strive for alteration and acceptance.

spans.text: Eosphorus, I know that you always seek to walk the path of clemency, to strive for alteration and acceptance.

units.rawText: But you must not let your guard down, and forget the lessons learnt in ages past.
units.displayText: But you must not let your guard down, and forget the lessons learnt in ages past.

spans.text: But you must not let your guard down, and forget the lessons learnt in ages past.

units.rawText: Eucharist is a Greater Sanctifier. How long has it been since the Reverse Babylon Tower produced an Apostate Greater Sanctifier? This far behind the front line, too!
units.displayText: Eucharist is a Greater Sanctifier. How long has it been since the Reverse Babylon Tower produced an Apostate Greater Sanctifier? This far behind the front line, too!

spans.text: Eucharist is a Greater Sanctifier. How long has it been since the Reverse Babylon Tower produced an Apostate Greater Sanctifier? This far behind the front line, too!

units.rawText: I will deal with this matter appropriately. I will personally... cleanse Eucharist.
units.displayText: I will deal with this matter appropriately. I will personally... cleanse Eucharist.

spans.text: I will deal with this matter appropriately. I will personally... cleanse Eucharist.

units.rawText: Hesperus met eyes with Eosphorus for a period, expressionless.
units.displayText: Hesperus met eyes with Eosphorus for a period, expressionless.

spans.text: Hesperus met eyes with Eosphorus for a period, expressionless.

units.rawText: You've disappointed them.
units.displayText: You've disappointed them.

spans.text: You've disappointed them.

units.rawText: Do not allow it again.
units.displayText: Do not allow it again.

spans.text: Do not allow it again.

units.rawText: [Beep—]
units.displayText: [Beep—]

spans.text: [Beep—]

units.displayText: [Special Communications Channel Closed.]

spans.text: [Special Communications Channel Closed.]

units.displayText: Eosphorus reclined in his seat, brows tightening.

spans.text: Eosphorus reclined in his seat, brows tightening.
